title: ClientError::Parse(String) loses structured parse error
description: ClientError::Parse(String) converts serde_json::Error to String at the call site (e.g. .map_err(|e| ClientError::Parse(e.to_string()))). Callers cannot inspect line/column information or distinguish missing-field errors from type-mismatch errors. The serde_json::Error already implements Display+Debug+Error; wrapping it in a Box<dyn Error> or storing the raw error type would preserve structure. Idiomatic alternative: ClientError::Parse(#[from] serde_json::Error) with a distinct variant, or ClientError::Parse(Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>).
